0.name: TEXT_HOUFIXMANSIONOFFICER_00363_TALK_000_000
0.description: Welcome to <hex:020946E802FF08546F706D617374FF0B4C696C792048696C6C73FF157468652053756C74616E61277320427265617468FF0C4B6F62616920476F74656EFF0A496E676C657369646503> Apartments! Whether you've come with an eye to buy or simply a question to ask, my services are at your disposal.

10.name: TEXT_HOUFIXMANSIONOFFICER_00363_SELECT_006_007
10.description: Restrictions on the sale of used furnishings.

13.name: TEXT_HOUFIXMANSIONOFFICER_00363_TALK_006_001_001
13.description: These apartments are designed to cater for individual adventurers with Grand Company affiliation.

14.name: TEXT_HOUFIXMANSIONOFFICER_00363_TALK_006_001_002
14.description: When you buy one of our rooms, you are purchasing a sanctuary─your own private space that you are free to decorate as you please!

15.name: TEXT_HOUFIXMANSIONOFFICER_00363_SYSTEM_006_001_003
15.description: In addition to furnishings, the following features can be placed inside an apartment: flowerpots, orchestrions, summoning bells, crystal bells, armoires, and specialist NPCs.

16.name: TEXT_HOUFIXMANSIONOFFICER_00363_SYSTEM_006_001_004
16.description: Upon purchasing an apartment, you will gain access to the building's chocobo stable. As well as raising your own chocobo and coloring its plumage, you will also be able to care for the mounts of other residents.

17.name: TEXT_HOUFIXMANSIONOFFICER_00363_SYSTEM_006_001_005
17.description: Furthermore, you will gain the option to teleport directly to the entrance of your apartment building.

18.name: TEXT_HOUFIXMANSIONOFFICER_00363_SYSTEM_006_002_001
18.description: Apartments are available for 500,000 gil. Before you can purchase an apartment, however, you must first attain level 50 in a single class.

19.name: TEXT_HOUFIXMANSIONOFFICER_00363_SYSTEM_006_002_002
19.description: Furthermore, you must hold a rank of second lieutenant or above in one of the Grand Companies.

20.name: TEXT_HOUFIXMANSIONOFFICER_00363_SYSTEM_006_002_003
20.description: In order to purchase an apartment in Kobai Goten, you must first complete the main scenario quest “Not without Incident.”

21.name: TEXT_HOUFIXMANSIONOFFICER_00363_SYSTEM_006_002_004
21.description: In order to purchase an apartment in Ingleside, you must first complete the main scenario quest “Litany of Peace.”

22.name: TEXT_HOUFIXMANSIONOFFICER_00363_TALK_006_003_001
22.description: In order to vacate your apartment, you must first remove all furnishings.

23.name: TEXT_HOUFIXMANSIONOFFICER_00363_SYSTEM_006_003_002
23.description: Once your apartment is completely empty, open the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Housing<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> menu while in the apartment lobby, select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Estate Settings<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, and then select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Vacate Apartment<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

24.name: TEXT_HOUFIXMANSIONOFFICER_00363_SYSTEM_006_003_003
24.description: Please be warned that you will not be refunded the purchase price of the apartment.

25.name: TEXT_HOUFIXMANSIONOFFICER_00363_TALK_006_004_001
25.description: We like our residents to feel at home─should you be unhappy with the room's appearance, the walls and floors are yours to change as you will!

26.name: TEXT_HOUFIXMANSIONOFFICER_00363_SYSTEM_006_004_002
26.description: You can customize the interior walls, flooring, and ceiling lights of your apartment.

27.name: TEXT_HOUFIXMANSIONOFFICER_00363_SYSTEM_006_004_003
27.description: To change any of these elements, open the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Housing<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> menu while inside your apartment, and select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Remodel Interior<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

28.name: TEXT_HOUFIXMANSIONOFFICER_00363_SYSTEM_006_004_004
28.description: Placed fixtures will be returned to your inventory when they are replaced by another fixture.

29.name: TEXT_HOUFIXMANSIONOFFICER_00363_TALK_006_005_001
29.description: New apartments are unfurnished─a blank canvas, if you will. You might fill the space with joyous clutter, or maintain a sparse minimalism. The choice is yours!

30.name: TEXT_HOUFIXMANSIONOFFICER_00363_SYSTEM_006_005_002
30.description: To place furnishings, open the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Housing<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> menu while inside your apartment, and select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Indoor Furnishings<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

31.name: TEXT_HOUFIXMANSIONOFFICER_00363_SYSTEM_006_005_003
31.description: Please note that the locations where you may place a furnishing are dictated by its type.

32.name: TEXT_HOUFIXMANSIONOFFICER_00363_TALK_006_006_001
32.description: The lighting within an apartment can be adjusted to suit your mood, whether you prefer bright and cheery, or dim and subdued.

33.name: TEXT_HOUFIXMANSIONOFFICER_00363_SYSTEM_006_006_002
33.description: To adjust the brightness of your apartment's lighting, open the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Housing<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> menu while inside and select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Interior Settings<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

34.name: TEXT_HOUFIXMANSIONOFFICER_00363_SYSTEM_006_007_001
34.description: Placing a furnishing will <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>bind<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> it to you, preventing future trade or sale to other players.

35.name: TEXT_HOUFIXMANSIONOFFICER_00363_SYSTEM_006_007_002
35.description: Moreover, certain furnishings cannot be retrieved once placed, and will be permanently discarded upon removal.

36.name: TEXT_HOUFIXMANSIONOFFICER_00363_SYSTEM_006_007_003
36.description: You will be prompted to confirm your decision before placing or removing these furnishings.

37.name: TEXT_HOUFIXMANSIONOFFICER_00363_TALK_006_008_001
37.description: When you purchase one of our apartments, you also gain access to our exclusive chocobo stable! You'll find it just outside the entrance to the building.

38.name: TEXT_HOUFIXMANSIONOFFICER_00363_SYSTEM_006_008_002
38.description: Access the chocobo stable after buying an apartment, and select “Learn about Chocobo Raising” to begin caring for your steed.

43.name: TEXT_HOUFIXMANSIONOFFICER_00363_SYSTEM_003_000
43.description: In order to purchase an apartment, you must first attain level 50 in a single class.

44.name: TEXT_HOUFIXMANSIONOFFICER_00363_SYSTEM_003_001
44.description: Furthermore, you must hold a rank of second lieutenant or above in one of the Grand Companies.

45.name: TEXT_HOUFIXMANSIONOFFICER_00363_TALK_004_000
45.description: Ah. I'm afraid we haven't any vacancies at this time.

46.name: TEXT_HOUFIXMANSIONOFFICER_00363_TALK_004_001
46.description: Your only options are to wait until an owner relinquishes a room, or try your luck at another apartment building. My apologies.

48.name: TEXT_HOUFIXMANSIONOFFICER_00363_TALK_005_001
48.description: Provide me the sum of 500,000 gil, and we shall make you the proud owner of a new apartment!

52.name: TEXT_HOUFIXMANSIONOFFICER_00363_KUGANE_NOT_OPENED_1
52.description: Welcome to Kobai Goten Apartments! Our rooms are currently undergoing finishing touches, and will soon be available for purchase. We thank you for your patience.

53.name: TEXT_HOUFIXMANSIONOFFICER_00363_KUGANE_NOT_OPENED_2
53.description: At present, Kobai Goten is open for display only. Apartment sales will commence at a later time.

54.name: TEXT_HOUFIXMANSIONOFFICER_00363_KUGANE_NOT_ARROWED_TO_BUY
54.description: In order to purchase an apartment in Kobai Goten, you must first complete the main scenario quest “Not without Incident.”

55.name: TEXT_HOUFIXMANSIONOFFICER_00363_ISHGARD_NOT_OPENED_1
55.description: Welcome to Ingleside Apartments! Our rooms are currently undergoing finishing touches, and will soon be available for purchase. We thank you for your patience.

56.name: TEXT_HOUFIXMANSIONOFFICER_00363_ISHGARD_NOT_OPENED_2
56.description: At present, Ingleside is open for display only. Apartment sales will commence at a later time.

57.name: TEXT_HOUFIXMANSIONOFFICER_00363_ISHGARD_NOT_ARROWED_TO_BUY
57.description: In order to purchase an apartment in Ingleside, you must first complete the main scenario quest “Litany of Peace.”

Our rooms are currently undergoing finishing touches, and will soon be available for purchase. We thank you for your patience.
